    (OLD.status = 'active' AND NEW.status = 'closed') OR
    (OLD.status = 'closed' AND NEW.status = 'archived')))
  OR (OLD.status != 'draft' AND (OLD.start_at != NEW.start_at OR OLD.end_at != NEW.end_at
    OR OLD.campaign_timezone != NEW.campaign_timezone OR OLD.vote_start_date != NEW.vote_start_date OR OLD.vote_end_date != NEW.vote_end_date))

triggers.name: final_case_file_guard
triggers.sql:
CREATE TRIGGER final_case_file_guard BEFORE INSERT ON case_files
WHEN (NEW.object_key LIKE 'proofs/final/%' OR NEW.upload_intent_id IS NOT NULL) AND NOT EXISTS(
 SELECT 1 FROM proof_upload_intents i JOIN cases c ON coalesce(c.upload_intent_id,c.upload_session_id)=i.session_id
 WHERE c.id=NEW.case_id AND i.consumed_case_id=c.id AND i.state='consumed'
 AND NEW.id=i.proof_id AND NEW.object_key=i.object_key AND NEW.size=i.size AND NEW.content_type=i.content_type
 AND NEW.etag IS NOT NULL AND length(NEW.etag)>0
 AND ((i.completion_mode='legacy' AND NEW.upload_object_key=i.object_key AND NEW.upload_intent_id IS NULL)
 OR (i.completion_mode='direct' AND NEW.upload_intent_id=i.session_id AND NEW.upload_object_key IS NULL)))
BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT,'Final proof linkage mismatch'); END

triggers.name: final_case_guard
triggers.sql:
CREATE TRIGGER final_case_guard BEFORE INSERT ON cases
WHEN (NEW.upload_intent_id IS NOT NULL AND NOT EXISTS(
 SELECT 1 FROM proof_upload_intents i WHERE i.session_id=NEW.upload_intent_id AND i.completion_mode='direct'
 AND i.state='prepared' AND i.consumed_case_id IS NULL AND i.expires_at>strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%fZ','now')
 AND i.campaign_id=NEW.campaign_id AND i.member_id IS NEW.member_id))
 OR (EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM proof_upload_intents WHERE session_id=NEW.upload_session_id) AND NOT EXISTS(
 SELECT 1 FROM proof_upload_intents i WHERE i.session_id=NEW.upload_session_id AND i.completion_mode='legacy'
 AND i.state='sealed' AND i.expires_at>strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%fZ','now') AND i.consumed_case_id IS NULL
 AND i.campaign_id=NEW.campaign_id AND i.member_id IS NEW.member_id))
BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT,'Final proof is not consumable'); END

triggers.name: final_case_consume
triggers.sql:
CREATE TRIGGER final_case_consume AFTER INSERT ON cases
BEGIN
 UPDATE proof_upload_intents SET state='consumed',consumed_case_id=NEW.id,consumed_at=NEW.created_at
 WHERE (session_id=NEW.upload_session_id AND completion_mode='legacy' AND state='sealed')
 OR (session_id=NEW.upload_intent_id AND completion_mode='direct' AND state='prepared');
 SELECT (CASE WHEN NEW.upload_intent_id IS NOT NULL AND NOT EXISTS(
  SELECT 1 FROM proof_upload_intents WHERE session_id=NEW.upload_intent_id AND state='consumed' AND consumed_case_id=NEW.id)
 THEN RAISE(ABORT,'Direct intent consumption failed') END);
END

 OR (NEW.parent_id IS NOT NULL AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM image_mutation_operations p
   WHERE p.id=NEW.parent_id AND p.kind IN('admin_upload','admin_campaign') AND p.state='active'))
 OR (NEW.kind!='inventory' AND (
   EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM storage_capacity WHERE id=1 AND inventory_id IS NOT NULL)
   OR NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM image_maintenance_control WHERE id=1 AND (mode='open' OR
     (mode='draining' AND NEW.kind='delete' AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM image_mutation_operations p
       WHERE p.id=NEW.parent_id AND p.kind IN('admin_upload','admin_campaign') AND p.state='active'))))))

    WHERE r.run_id = NEW.run_id AND r.leaderboard_id = NEW.leaderboard_id AND r.status = 'building' AND NEW.rank <= b.top_n)

WHEN OLD.status != 'building' OR NEW.status != 'success' OR NEW.run_id != OLD.run_id
  OR NEW.leaderboard_id != OLD.leaderboard_id OR NEW.generated_at != OLD.generated_at OR NEW.definition_version != OLD.definition_version
  OR NEW.source_count != OLD.source_count OR NEW.source_last_transaction_id IS NOT OLD.source_last_transaction_id
  OR NEW.definition_json != OLD.definition_json OR NEW.integrity_errors != OLD.integrity_errors OR NEW.row_count != (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM leaderboard_results WHERE run_id = OLD.run_id)
  OR (NEW.row_count > 0 AND NEW.row_count != (SELECT MAX(rank) FROM leaderboard_results WHERE run_id = OLD.run_id))

triggers.name: duplicate_enqueue
triggers.sql:
CREATE TRIGGER duplicate_enqueue AFTER INSERT ON proof_exact_hashes
BEGIN
  INSERT INTO proof_duplicate_jobs(file_id,member_id,campaign_id,sha256,case_internal_id,case_created_at,state,next_attempt_at,updated_at)
    SELECT NEW.file_id,c.member_id,c.campaign_id,NEW.sha256,c.id,c.created_at,
      CASE WHEN c.member_id IS NULL THEN 'not_applicable' ELSE 'pending' END,
      CASE WHEN c.member_id IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE 0 END,NEW.verified_at
    FROM case_files f JOIN cases c ON c.id=f.case_id WHERE f.id=NEW.file_id;
  -- Only one scoped group changes synchronously. Existing stale results are
  -- logically pending immediately; bounded background reconciliation resets them.
  -- A scoped minimum metadata register is updated by one PK UPSERT. There is
  -- no SELECT of matching/prior proofs and no classification on this path.
  INSERT INTO proof_duplicate_groups(member_id,campaign_id,sha256,canonical_file_id,case_created_at,case_internal_id,dirty,after_file_id)
    SELECT member_id,campaign_id,sha256,file_id,case_created_at,case_internal_id,0,''
    FROM proof_duplicate_jobs WHERE file_id=NEW.file_id AND member_id IS NOT NULL
    ON CONFLICT(member_id,campaign_id,sha256) DO UPDATE SET canonical_file_id=excluded.canonical_file_id,
      case_created_at=excluded.case_created_at,case_internal_id=excluded.case_internal_id,
      dirty=1,after_file_id='',generation=generation+1
      WHERE (excluded.case_created_at,excluded.case_internal_id,excluded.canonical_file_id)
        <(proof_duplicate_groups.case_created_at,proof_duplicate_groups.case_internal_id,proof_duplicate_groups.canonical_file_id);
END

 (OLD.state='uploaded' AND NEW.state IN ('sealed','deleting')) OR
 (OLD.state='sealed' AND NEW.state IN ('consumed','deleting')) OR
 (OLD.completion_mode='direct' AND OLD.state='prepared' AND NEW.state='consumed') OR
 (OLD.state='deleting' AND NEW.state='deleted')))
 OR (OLD.consumed_case_id IS NOT NULL AND NEW.consumed_case_id IS NOT OLD.consumed_case_id)

BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT,'Invalid upload transition'); END

 OR (NEW.mode='running' AND (NEW.writer_policy IS NOT 'create_only_v1' OR NEW.evidence_hash IS NULL OR length(NEW.evidence_hash)!=64
 OR NEW.verified_until<=CAST(strftime('%s','now') AS INTEGER)
 OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM storage_archive_dispatches WHERE state!='completed')
 OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM cold_proofs WHERE state='deleting')))
 OR (NEW.mode='paused' AND (EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM storage_archive_dispatches WHERE state!='completed')
 OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM cold_proofs WHERE state='deleting')))

triggers.sql:
CREATE TRIGGER image_inventory_claim BEFORE UPDATE OF inventory_id ON storage_capacity
WHEN OLD.inventory_id IS NULL AND NEW.inventory_id IS NOT NULL AND (
 NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM image_maintenance_control WHERE id=1 AND mode IN('open','closed') AND legacy_status='operator_attested')
 OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM image_mutation_operations WHERE state IN('active','unknown') AND kind!='inventory')
 OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM proof_upload_intents WHERE write_token IS NOT NULL)
 OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM storage_archive_dispatches WHERE state!='completed')
 OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM cold_proofs WHERE state='deleting') OR NEW.reserved_bytes!=0)
BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT,'IMAGE_INVENTORY_BUSY'); END

triggers.sql:
CREATE TRIGGER image_inventory_pin AFTER UPDATE OF inventory_id ON storage_capacity
WHEN OLD.inventory_id IS NULL AND NEW.inventory_id IS NOT NULL
BEGIN
 INSERT INTO image_mutation_operations(id,kind,generation,state,created_at)
 SELECT NEW.inventory_id,'inventory',generation,'active',CAST(strftime('%s','now') AS INTEGER) FROM image_maintenance_control WHERE id=1;
 INSERT INTO storage_audit VALUES(NEW.inventory_id||':image-pin',CAST(strftime('%s','now') AS INTEGER),'inventory_image_pin',NEW.inventory_id,'{}');
END

triggers.sql:
CREATE TRIGGER image_inventory_publish BEFORE UPDATE OF inventory_id ON storage_capacity
WHEN OLD.inventory_id IS NOT NULL AND NEW.inventory_id IS NULL AND NEW.trusted_until>0 AND (
 NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM image_maintenance_control m JOIN image_mutation_operations o ON o.id=OLD.inventory_id
   WHERE m.id=1 AND m.mode IN('open','closed') AND m.legacy_status='operator_attested'
   AND o.kind='inventory' AND o.state='active' AND o.generation=m.generation)
 OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM image_mutation_operations WHERE kind!='inventory' AND state IN('active','unknown'))
 OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM proof_upload_intents WHERE write_token IS NOT NULL)
 OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM storage_archive_dispatches WHERE state!='completed')
 OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM cold_proofs WHERE state='deleting') OR NEW.reserved_bytes!=0)
BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT,'IMAGE_INVENTORY_UNTRUSTED'); END

 AND (NEW.blocked!=1 OR NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM image_maintenance_control WHERE id=1 AND mode IN('draining','closed')))
BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT,'IMAGE_INVENTORY_ABORT_FENCED'); END

CREATE TRIGGER image_inventory_terminal AFTER UPDATE OF inventory_id ON storage_capacity
WHEN OLD.inventory_id IS NOT NULL AND NEW.inventory_id IS NULL
BEGIN UPDATE image_mutation_operations SET state=CASE WHEN NEW.trusted_until>0 THEN 'completed' ELSE 'aborted' END,
 finished_at=CAST(strftime('%s','now') AS INTEGER),outcome=CASE WHEN NEW.trusted_until>0 THEN 'published' ELSE 'invalidated' END
 WHERE id=OLD.inventory_id AND kind='inventory' AND state='active'; END

 AND used_bytes+reserved_bytes+NEW.bytes<9500000000) THEN RAISE(ABORT,'R2_STORAGE_CAPACITY_EXCEEDED') END;
END
